A large explosion occurs on the left side of the frame, producing a bright orange fireball and a rapidly expanding dust/debris cloud that obscures part of the scene.

A motorcycle lies on its side on the road surface, indicating it has crashed or been knocked down; dust and motion blur suggest recent impact.
